timeline.summary: Elspeth knocks Ajani out, stabs Jace and vanishes with the Sylex.
timeline.quote: she knocked Ajani unconscious and ran further into the Seedcore

timeline.quote: They were too late, as Nissa Revane had been compleated before they arrived
